title: journey.toml, read as TOML: what a journey is and where each stage stands
description: stages.<name>.inputs holds the sha256 of each input as it was when the stage was last accepted; stages.<name>.output the sha256 of the output then (its sign-off). prompt is the brief the accepted output was made with, rendered the last brief shown. status compares these with the files now and reruns nothing.
